items.title: The Single Guy (S02E02- Best Man)
items.description: This sitcom from the makers of Seinfeld has never had any home video nor streaming release. Here is the second episode from the second season, where Jonathan is tempted into being a best man at a stranger's wedding.

items.title: The Single Guy- Mother Love (S2E16)
items.description: This episode of the '90s sitcom The Single Guy is named for Jonathan's mother dating his boss. Also look for Russell and Marie rehearsing for Rome and Juliet.

items.title: Havin' a Beer with Mike - "The Hangover Diaries of a Single Guy"
items.description: The Hangover Diaries of a Single Guys is a DVD that features independently produced TV episodes from the irreverent cynical comedy, Havin' a Beer with Mike. Coming soon, the episodes from the DVD will be available on Blip.tv .

items.title: 20 Years Of Must See TV (2002) WOC
items.description: <div>In this result of the nostalgia wave that overtook American TV in the wake of 9-11, Eric McCormack hosts a look back at NBC's popular Thursday night programs during the previous 20 years. The program features interviews with dozens of producers, writers and stars of "Must See TV" history.  <br
